106-Driving Signs, Signals, Rules: No automobile or motor vehicle shall drive or back over the curb on any street, except at a point where a driveway is provided. In the operation of motor vehicles on the streets of Pine Mountain, the following rules shall be observed.

- 1. When two vehicles shall approach each other on intersecting streets, the vehicle approaching from the right shall have the right-of-way except where traffic signals control.

- 2. When any person operating a motor vehicle shall desire to make a right turn, he shall indicate his intention by extending his left arm out of the window on the driver's side of the vehicle, the hand extended upward in a 45 degree angle.

- 3. When any person operating a motor vehicle shall desire to make a left turn, he shall indicate his intention by extending his left arm out of the window on the driver's side of the vehicle, the hand extended outward, parallel to the ground. 4. When any person operating a motor vehicle shall desire to make a stop, he shall indicate his intention by extending his left arm out of the window on the dirver's side of the vehicle, letting his hand drop toward the ground.
